sourceSteps: 将稳定球放在地面上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
acceptedReferenceObservation: Prone hips supported on fixed ball, straight legs extend to floor and wall-braced feet. Paws crossed at chest. Endpoint raises the upper torso into a near-straight continuation of legs without exaggerated lumbar arch; same foot and hip support.
renderingAssumption: Source permits crossed chest paws. Warm ivory wall is the source-described stable foot support; no exact body/hip angle is asserted.
